title: “How to Achieve Peace”SCA Hanukkah Message by Mrs. Rachel Abraham

chapters.title: Prioritizing Shabbat and Hanukkah candles
chapters.about: Mishne Torah Halal Hanukkah 414 and Shalom Bait

chapters.title: The order of achieving peace
chapters.about: Building peace from the home to the world

summary: Mrs. Rachel Abraham discusses the priority of Shalom Bait in relation to the lights of Hanukkah and Shabbat. She explores the idea that achieving peace on a national scale begins with fostering respectful relationships within the home and the immediate community. The class references the role of Aaron Hakohen as a model for pursuing peace.
questions: Should I prioritize buying Shabbat candles or Hanukkah candles?
How does domestic peace relate to national peace?
What does it mean to be an Ohov Shalom and a Rodev Shalom?
How did Aaron Hakohen influence peace among Ben Israel?
